## Disclosure

AI assistance was used. The changes were reviewed and tested manually.

## Overview

**JUST FOR DEMO, DO NOT MERGE.** This branch exists only to measure what the three build-time PRs do *together*; nothing in it is new. It is `main` plus, in order:

- #62716 - paged attention instantiations generated from one variant list, Navi set not instantiated without gfx11/gfx12, `<torch/all.h>` trimmed
- #62717 - topk softplus-sqrt instantiations split per (gating dtype, indices dtype) and per wavefront size
- #62718 - skinny GEMMs split per kernel family, `<torch/all.h>` trimmed

Each of them is reviewed on its own; the joint build time is the only thing this branch is for.

## Claims

| | `MAX_JOBS=16` | `MAX_JOBS=64` |
|---|---|---|
| `main` | 134 s | 86 s |
| this branch | 88 s | 50 s |
| | **-46 s (-34 %)** | **-36 s (-42 %)** |

Built `.so`, same toolchain, same flags:

| | `_rocm_C` | `_moe_C_stable_libtorch` |
|---|---|---|
| `main` | 209.1 MB | 32.5 MB |
| this branch | 189.3 MB (-9 %) | 20.7 MB (-36 %) |

## Validation

`MAX_JOBS=N pip install --no-cache-dir -e . --no-deps --no-build-isolation`, four builds run one after the other in the same container, each from a clean tree (`vllm/*.so` and `build/` removed beforehand), so every number is a cold build with no ccache and no shared CMake cache. 0 errors in all four logs.

| build | `MAX_JOBS=16` | `MAX_JOBS=64` |
|---|---|---|
| `main` (`db3b0f0fae`) | 134 s | 86 s |
| this branch (`8a80b55e9a`) | 88 s | 50 s |

Environment, one host:

- CPU: AMD EPYC 9575F, 64 cores / 256 threads
- GPU: 8x AMD Instinct MI350X (251 GiB each), MI350X used for the kernel tests
- ROCm 10.0, `torch 2.12.0+rocm10.0.0`, `PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH=gfx950`, `PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_ENABLED=0`

The three PRs were also tested on this host, on the same revision that is in this branch:

| PR | test file | result |
|---|---|---|
| #62716 | `tests/kernels/attention/test_attention.py` | 393 passed |
| #62717 | `tests/kernels/moe/test_topk_softplus_sqrt.py` | 1673 passed, 7 skipped |
| #62718 | `tests/kernels/quantization/test_rocm_skinny_gemms.py`, `tests/kernels/test_bf16_skinny_gemm.py` | 2519 passed, 636 skipped (same as `main`) |

## Details

Nothing to review here. The branch is a plain concatenation of the three PR branches; the only resolution needed was the `CMakeLists.txt` hunk where #62718's skinny block and #62716's paged attention block are adjacent. Use `git log` to see the individual commits, and the three PRs for the rationale and the per-PR numbers.

### Left to do

Nothing - this branch will not be merged. The real PRs are #62716, #62717 and #62718.

+torch::Tensor wvSplitK(const at::Tensor& in_a, const at::Tensor& in_b,

+  {                                                                           \
+    dim3 block(_THRDS, _WVPRGRP);                                             \
